card.name: Safety wording in warning statements
card.fires_on: The word "safe" in "ensure safe use of PD-1/PD-L1 blocking antibodies". It also fires on a few other safety-related spots, such as "IS" in the "RISKS" boxed-warning heading.

modes.label: ensure safe use
modes.description: The word "safe" after "ensure" in the immune-mediated adverse reaction warning for PD-1/PD-L1 antibodies.
modes.example: Early identification and management of immune-mediated adverse reactions are essential to ensure<< safe>> use of PD-1/PD-L

modes.label: RISKS in boxed warning
modes.description: The "IS" piece inside "RISKS" in the heading "SERIOUS AND LIFE-THREATENING RISKS FROM USE OF" a drug.
modes.example: WARNING: SERIOUS AND LIFE-THREATENING R<<IS>>KS FROM USE OF METHADONE HY

modes.label: Reactions avoided
modes.description: A verb meaning that reactions were prevented, in a sentence about withholding a drug.
modes.example: In the same patients, these reactions were<< avoided>> when ACE inhibitors were temporarily withheld, but

card.plain: It marks words about safety and avoiding harm inside warning text, mostly the phrase "ensure safe use".
